item.name: 80s Train
item.summary: The 80s Train was a train created as part of a collaboration event between Dead Rails and Stranger Things '85.
item.cost: Participated in the Stranger Things: '85 watch party.
item.features: More max speed; Enclosed boxcar; Purple headlights; Shiny hull; Two pieces; Additional small car at the back
